fields.name: header
fields.comment: Classic PCAP 24-byte global header only; not PCAPNG or packet decoding

fields.name: magic
fields.comment: D4 C3 B2 A1: microseconds. 4D 3C B2 A1: nanoseconds. Use the big-endian template for reversed magic.

fields.name: reserved1
fields.comment: Historical timezone field; ignored by current readers

fields.name: reserved2
fields.comment: Historical timestamp accuracy field; ignored by current readers

fields.name: linkTypeAndFlags
fields.comment: Low 16 bits identify link type; high bits may carry FCS metadata. Displayed raw.
